MZGram now has its own package and installs as a separate app beside Telegram: install this version by hand once (the update button of 1.0.3 cannot install it) and sign in.

The archive of the old MZGram is not moved: Export of the archive did not work in 1.0.3 (it closed the app), so this version starts with an empty archive. Files of archived messages stay in Downloads/MZGram/Saved Attachments. You can remove the old MZGram once you no longer need its archive. Export and Import work from the next version, for moving the archive in the future.
